projecthero.power.power_01_super_strengt: Super Strength
Enhanced physiology built on raw force: throw anything you can get your hands on — creatures, players, even the ground itself — and land every leap like a hero.
Experimental Adrenal Serum
Drink the serum, then take an electrical surge from an Overloaded Redstone Coil or Charged Copper Plates (or a natural lightning strike).
Ground Slam

G: 17 damage in a 5-block radius, slows for 2s and launches enemies up. Used airborne it becomes a dive that hits harder the farther you fell (up to 34) and ends in a hero landing that shrugs off the fall. Leaves the ground intact. 6.8s cooldown.
Power Leap

X: hold to charge, release to launch yourself the way you are looking — 11 blocks at a tap, up to 38 fully charged — then touch down in a crater-cracking hero landing: 7 damage in a 2.5-block radius at a tap, up to 22 in 5.5 blocks fully charged. No fall damage. 2.5s cooldown.
Bull Rush

C: hold for 5s to charge (damage resistance and full knockback resistance while charging), then plough forward for 8s at double sprint speed with a 4-block step assist, hitting everything in your path for 24 and a 5-block knockback. Sneak + hold C for 5s = Impact Smash: up to 72 damage in a 20-block radius that shatters soft blocks. Releasing early cancels. One shared cooldown: 34s after a rush, 76s after a smash.
Maximum Effort

Z: 15 seconds of everything turned up — every Super Strength move and your fists hit twice as hard (Bull Rush / Impact Smash +25%), slams grow 50% wider, you are immune to knockback, take 30% less damage, move and jump faster, and ability cooldowns are halved. Red veins light up under your skin. 51s cooldown.
Haymaker

R: a three-punch combo — jab (10), cross (12), then a launching haymaker (22) that sends the target flying and knocks their shield down. Each follow-up must land within 1.5s; the full combo goes on a 5.1s cooldown, dropping it half way costs 2.5s. Snaps onto the nearest enemy in reach if you are not aiming at one.
Grab & Throw

V: grab the creature or player in front of you and hoist it over your head — or, if there is none, rip the block you are looking at straight out of the world. Press again to throw: a thrown creature takes 12 when it slams into a wall, the floor or another mob (and so do they); a thrown block hits for 19 and shatters for 8 around it. Sneak + V sets a creature down gently. Anything held is dropped after 15s. Containers and obsidian-hard blocks cannot be ripped; with terrain damage off the block is copied, not removed. 3.4s cooldown.
Thunderclap

H: clap your hands and send a 120° cone of air rolling 9 blocks out: 9 damage, a hard shove and a 2.5s stun (Slowness V + Weakness), arrows turned around, and every fire in the cone snuffed out — on creatures, on you and on the ground. 8s cooldown.
Rip & Hurl

N: tear a boulder out of the ground in front of you — it rises over your head in half a second — and hurl it where you aim: 26 damage to whatever it strikes and 14 to everything within 3 blocks as it shatters. With terrain damage on, the block it came from is gone. 9.4s cooldown.
Unarmed hits deal 14 damage with +150% knockback; a held tool adds its own damage on top
15% less damage from all sources, 20% less from explosions, 70% knockback resistance
Jump roughly 2 blocks high
Your fists count as a stone tool whatever you're holding; +25% mining speed, +15% sprint speed, +30% swim speed
65% less fall damage

Hold the attack key for 2s (not while aimed at a block you could mine), then release for a Charged Punch: 24 damage to whatever is in front of you, massive knockback, disables shields. 2.5s cooldown — you can keep winding it up while it recharges.
Laser Vision
A photonic mutation that runs on heat: every beam heats your eyes, and the hotter they run the sharper — and deadlier — the beam. Push it too far and you overheat.
Photon Sensitivity Serum
Drink the serum and look into an active Experimental Light Projector / Beacon Lens for several seconds.
Heat Vision

R: hold to fire two continuous beams from your eyes — 4.8 damage every half-second, ramping up to 2.5x the longer you hold, igniting what it touches. Shift + R switches to utility mode, mining blocks as fast as a diamond tool but running hotter.
Maximum Output

Z: hold for 4s, gathering heat at your eyes, then unleash a thick 48-block beam for 3s: 9.6 damage a tick to what it touches, fire, and a 41-damage burst every half-second where it lands. +250 heat, 55s cooldown.
Thermal Vision
C: toggle thermal highlighting of nearby living entities, through walls and cover (only you can see it). Keeps your eyes warm: a slow trickle of heat, and heat does not vent while it is on.
Piercing Lance

G: hold to charge (2s for full), release to fire a 40-block needle of light that runs through up to 4 creatures for 18–29 damage and cuts straight through glass, leaves and panes (with terrain damage on). +90 heat, 7.5s cooldown.
Recoil Blast

X: fire a point-blank blast where you are looking — at the ground, a wall, behind you — and the recoil throws you the other way. 9.6 damage and fire in a 2.5-block splash where it lands; no fall damage for 4s after. +50 heat, 4.25s cooldown.
Ricochet Shot
V: a bolt that caroms off up to 3 surfaces over 48 blocks, burning everything it passes through — 11 damage, +25% after every bounce. Lights any TNT it hits. +40 heat, 3.5s cooldown.
Sweeping Arc
H: swing the beam through a 150° arc in half a second, 14 blocks out — 14.4 damage and fire to everything it crosses. +80 heat, 8.5s cooldown.
Cauterize
N: vent all of your heat into your own wounds: heals 3 health, up to 16 at a full gauge, puts you out and clears Wither and Poison. Needs at least 60 heat. 14s cooldown.

Heat (0–575): every beam adds heat, and every beam hits up to 60% harder the hotter your eyes are (past 60% a white-hot core runs down the beam). A full gauge overheats you — 3s locked out while it vents. Heat vents on its own a second after you stop firing.
Completely immune to blindness and darkness
Your eyes always glow red — brighter the hotter they run, blazing while you fire — you see clearly in darkness, and a subtle reticle marks any creature you look at
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.name: Flight
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.desc: True superhero flight built on speed: sprint in the air to climb through speed tiers and break the sound barrier, then bring the whole team along in your slipstream.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.trigge: Drink the serum, then activate an Unstable Gravity Plate, a Gravity Distortion Rig or a Pressure Chamber — or survive a fall of 14+ blocks.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.abilit: R: a burst forward (much stronger in flight) that shoulder-checks anything you dash into for 10 damage and a shove. 2.5s cooldown.

G: plunge dead straight down, all the way to the ground, then detonate in a hero landing. The impact scales with how far you fell — 18 damage plus 1.9 per block, up to 80 in a 12-block radius. 6.8s cooldown.

X (or double-tap jump): take off or land. Cruises at ~15 blocks/second; sprinting climbs three speed tiers, one every 2 seconds — 25, 32, 39 and finally 46 blocks/second, where you break the sound barrier with a sonic boom ring (6 damage and a shove to anything close). Let go of sprint and the tiers bleed off.

C: up to 25s of ~50 blocks/second supersonic flight, opening with a sonic boom and trailing a roaring vapour wake that throws 11-damage shockwaves. Press again to end it early; the 25.5s cooldown only starts once it ends.
Scoop up the creature or player you are looking at and carry them with you as you fly; press again to set them down.

Z: rocket straight up (about 30 blocks, stopping at a ceiling), hang at the top for a heartbeat, then come down like a meteor: 24 damage plus 1.2 per block fallen (up to 72) in a 7-block radius, with a sonic boom. No fall damage. 45s cooldown.
H: for 12s your squad-mates, your tamed pets and nearby villagers within 16 blocks are pulled along in your wake and kept on Slow Falling — bring the team with you. 16s cooldown.
N: snap-roll sideways (alternating left and right) with half a second of complete invulnerability. 3.5s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.passiv: Improved aerial control while falling -- steer your descent and fall more slowly
Full fall-damage immunity while flight is unlocked
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.d: A speedster mutation built on momentum: the longer you run, the harder everything hits.
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.t: Drink the serum, then activate Charged Copper Plates or an Overloaded Redstone Coil (or get struck by lightning).
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.a: G: snatch up the creature or player you are looking at and run with them held in front of you. It is a carry, not an attack: press again to set them down unharmed. 2.5s cooldown.
R: a blur of blows on everything in front of you — 4 hits of 2.4, plus one more hit for every 25 Momentum (up to 8). 1.5s cooldown.
X: an instant dash along the way you are moving; Momentum carries it up to 80% further. In speed modes, jumps also keep their momentum for long leaps. 1.7s cooldown.

Z: for 30s — sprint at roughly 64 blocks/second (a faster tier that replaces Speed Mode), +150% attack speed, a 10-block step assist, fall immunity, Momentum three times as fast, your melee and every Super Speed move hit twice as hard, and time slows around you: everything hostile within 12 blocks crawls. 42.5s cooldown.

C: toggle: sprint at roughly 32 blocks/second, +50% attack speed, run on water, 2-block step, +100% swim speed, -80% fall damage, Momentum twice as fast. Yellow lightning crackles over you and a speed trail follows your feet.

V: hold to run tight circles for up to 8s — the whirlwind drags every enemy within 10 blocks into its eye, lifting and battering those inside (3.6 damage every half-second), flinging back projectiles and putting out fire. 10.2s cooldown on release.
H: vibrate your molecules and step straight through up to two blocks of wall in front of you (never bedrock or other unbreakable blocks). 5.1s cooldown.
N: spend all your Momentum (at least 30) on a hurled bolt of static: 8 damage plus 0.14 per point of Momentum (up to 24), a brief slow, and it arcs on to one more enemy nearby for half. 4s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.p: Momentum (0–115): sprinting builds it (twice as fast in Speed Mode, three times in Overdrive); it bleeds away a second after you stop. Your base speed is normal — the real speed comes from Speed Mode and Overdrive

Higher step-up capability at speed. Sprint into a wall while looking steeply up it and you run straight up instead of stalling -- with a generous step assist so an overhanging lip or the rim of a deep hole doesn't stop you at the top.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.de: The ground under you is your ammo: every rock, spike, quake and pillar is torn from what you stand on, and the material changes the hit — deepslate is heavier and slower, sand throws a blinding cloud, netherrack sets things alight, ore veins hit far harder, ice slows. The HUD names the ground you are drawing on.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.tr: Drink while standing on natural stone/deepslate, ideally in a Geological Resonance Chamber.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.ab: X: ride a slab of the ground across it — you are carried the way you face at a gallop (faster on ice and sand, slower on deepslate), hopping single-block steps; anything you plough into takes 7 (x ground) and is bowled aside. Ends on a second press, after 15s, in water, or 1.5s after leaving the ground (4.3s cooldown). Sneak + X: Earth Swim — phase into the earth and swim through it fast for 12s, immune to everything but the void (25s cooldown).

H: the ground beneath whatever you look at (20 blocks) drops away — a pit three deep, sized to the target, that closes back up after 6s and lifts anything still inside back out. The target takes 10 (x ground), is dragged down and rooted for 3s. Players and boss-sized creatures are rooted without the dig. 12s cooldown.

N: a column of the local stone erupts. Look at a creature (20 blocks) and it bursts up under them — 12 damage (x ground) and a launch straight into the air. Look at nothing and it erupts under you, throwing you about 9 blocks up with 8s of no fall damage. The column stands for 4s. 7.7s cooldown.

R: tear a chunk out of the ground you stand on and hurl it — a real flying rock that looks like that block — for 11 damage (x ground: deepslate x1.35 and +knockback, ore x1.45, sand x0.85 plus a blinding dust cloud, netherrack sets alight, ice slows, x0.75 with no earth underfoot). 1.7s cooldown (x1.25 on deepslate). Sneak + R shakes the ground in a 10-block cone: 11 damage and Slowness II to all caught, 8.5s cooldown.

G: a line of stone spikes races 16 blocks along the ground the way you face, two blocks a tick — each creature it erupts under takes 15 (x ground), is thrown upward and slowed. The spikes are the local stone tipped with dripstone and crumble after 2.5s. Sneak + G auto-tracks every enemy in a 10-block cone instead (18 damage, a dripstone spike under each, 19s cooldown). 4.3s cooldown.

V: raise a 4x4 wall of the local stone for 25s — look up for a dome (left-click it to drop it), look down for a 20-block bridge. On sand it is sandstone, in the Nether netherrack, on deepslate cobbled deepslate, on ice packed ice. 7s cooldown. Sneak + V: Seismic Sense — every creature within 30 blocks glows for 12s.

Z: hold for 4.25s to charge, then a seismic pulse for 54 damage (x ground) across a 25-block radius, with nausea and slowness, that rips deep ravines out of the ground around you (a pad under your feet stays solid). 55s cooldown. Sneak as you press Z to charge a Colossal Rock instead — a boulder gathers overhead, then you hurl it: a huge projectile that detonates into a crater for 60 damage. 75s cooldown.

C: toggle a thick shell of stone skin (tinted by the ground you draw on) — Resistance II, 60% knockback resistance, 25% slower, +10 ability damage and +8 melee. Drains a strain bar (575, ~29s) that recharges once dropped; dropping it puts the slot on a 20s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.pa: Iron-tool hands whatever you hold; earth-family blocks break 50% faster; a bare-handed hit on an ore mines the whole vein; Haste while standing on earth. Sneak + right-click the ground empty-handed (or Sneak + V) for Seismic Sense.
projecthero.power.power_06_crystalkinesi: Crystalkinesis

Plant crystal nodes, then shatter them: every Crystal Shard grows a glowing amethyst node where it lands (up to 8 at once, 30s each), and your other moves detonate, split and empower them. Reflective amethyst armor, a crystal rail to glide on and a turret spire round out the kit.
Crystalline Resonance Serum
Drink the serum and stay near 8+ amethyst blocks (a natural geode, a Meteor Impact site) — or activate a Crystal Test Chamber or Geological Resonance Chamber.
Shatter
G: detonate every crystal node you own — each bursts for 16 damage to everything within 3 blocks (a Resonance Spire bursts half again as hard and wide). 4s cooldown; needs at least one node.
Crystal Path

X: glide along your aim — climbing or diving up to 35 degrees — while a rail of amethyst grows beneath you (solid for 3s, so others can follow) with a line of light running ahead. Up to 10s; press again to stop. No fall damage for 3s after. 5.1s cooldown.
Resonance Spire

H: grow a great crystal spire where you aim (16 blocks) — for 12s it fires a crystal shard (8 damage) at any hostile creature it can see within 14 blocks, about 1.7 times a second. It counts as a node: Shatter it for a bigger burst. 17s cooldown.
Refract

N: fire a beam of refracted light (32 blocks, 11 damage). If it passes through one of your nodes first, the node splits it into three beams (9 damage each) aimed at the nearest enemies it can see — fanned out ahead if there are none — and the node itself splits into three. 4.3s cooldown.
Crystal Shard

R: fire a flying amethyst shard for 13 damage and Slowness II — wherever it lands it grows a crystal node (on the block face it struck, or at the feet of the creature it hit). 1.7s cooldown. Sneak + R fires a volley of 5 shards (7 damage each), each planting its own node, 8.5s cooldown.
Crystal Eruption

Z: hold for 4.25s to charge, then a burst for 48 damage across a 20-block radius that raises a dense field of amethyst pillars — and every node you own shatters along with it. 60s cooldown. Sneak as you press Z to charge a Colossal Crystal instead: a huge crystal hurled at speed that explodes for 66 damage and leaves three nodes behind. 85s cooldown.
Crystal Prison
V: seal a target in an amethyst cage for 7s with Slowness X and a jump lock — they cannot move at all — and grow a crystal node beside the cage for a Shatter follow-up. 10.2s cooldown.
Crystal Armor

C: toggle thick amethyst plating with crystal spikes at the shoulders and spine — Resistance I, knockback resistance, +10 ability damage and +8 melee — that turns projectiles back: an arrow or fireball that hits you is cancelled and fired back at its shooter as a crystal shard (30 strain each). Drains a strain bar (575, ~29s) that recharges once dropped; 20s cooldown once dropped.
Your crystal nodes, spires and shards never harm you; nodes crack away on their own after 30s, when you leave, or when you plant a ninth.
projecthero.power.power_07_electrokinesi: Electrokinesis
A general electricity mutation — intentionally weaker than Thor’s true lightning. Every hit leaves static stacks on its target; three stacks stun it and set it up for Overcharge and Ion Pull.
Electrochemical Serum
Drink the serum and activate an Overloaded Redstone Coil while inside its discharge radius.
Electric Bolt
Fire a 26-block bolt for 12 damage that adds a static stack and briefly powers nearby redstone. 45 charge, 1.7s cooldown.
Chain Lightning

Lightning arcs from the enemy under your crosshair through up to 6 enemies for 11 damage each, adding a stack to every one. It jumps 8 blocks to a fresh target but 14 to one already carrying static — and always prefers the stacked one. 85 charge, 7s cooldown. Shift + G fires an EMP instead: redstone, powered doors, minecarts and robotic mobs within 20 blocks shut down for 6s (200 charge, 25s cooldown).
Bolt Form

Become a streak of lightning: jump up to 10 blocks along your aim (stopping short of walls), zapping everything along the path for 8 damage and a stack. Brief damage immunity and no fall damage on landing. 60 charge, 3.4s cooldown.
Electrical Storm

Hold Z for 4 seconds, lightning gathering over your raised arms, then call the storm on your aim point (up to 40 blocks): a 36-damage strike on everything within 5 blocks (+2 stacks), then four follow-up bolts over the next 2.4s for 10 each on enemies within 9 blocks — stacked targets first. Small crater when terrain damage is on. 575 charge, 55s cooldown.
Power Surge
Energise redstone from up to 50 blocks away — plants a short-lived block of redstone against whatever you are looking at. 70 charge, 6s cooldown.
Charged Mode

Toggle: a crackling blue shell and glowing blue eyes — +10 ability damage, +8 melee damage, Speed III, and every punch jolts for 3 more and adds a static stack. Drains your charge cell (~28s); getting hit while charged costs you 3 health and staggers you.
Overcharge

Detonate every static stack within 16 blocks: 8 damage per stack on each stacked enemy (+5 in Charged Mode), knocking them back; fully stacked targets are stunned again. Clears the stacks. 140 charge, 10s cooldown — needs at least one stacked enemy.
Ion Pull

Magnetise the static: every stacked enemy within 20 blocks is yanked to you and slowed. With nothing stacked it pulls the enemy under your crosshair instead and gives it a stack. 80 charge, 8s cooldown.
Lightning deals no damage to you at all; standing near a lightning strike instantly refills your charge cell

Every ability spends from a 1150-point charge cell (always shown) that refills on its own in about 40s, far faster during a thunderstorm. Abilities briefly power nearby redstone, and powered rails energise as you run over them.

Static stacks: every Electrokinesis hit adds one (max 3, lasting 8s). Stacked targets crackle with sparks everyone can see, take +10% Electrokinesis damage per stack, and are stunned for 1.5s when they reach three (then immune to that stun for 4s).
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.d: One Heat bar: every attack stokes it, and the hotter you run the harder you hit (up to +40%). Above 75% your flames burn blue — Fireball becomes a Flame Laser, Inferno a blue inferno, Flame Body scorches everything alight around you. At 100% you overheat: 1 damage a second and no heat-building move until you cool below 60% — or vent it all with Heat Wave. Heat bleeds away while you are not channelling, three times faster in water or rain. You never catch fire yourself.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.t: Drink the serum and remain in ordinary fire for several seconds while resistance protects you.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.a: X: hold to fly on twin jets of flame, driven along wherever you look at about 18 blocks a second — let go to coast, with no fall damage for 5s after. Builds heat fast (overheating or diving into water cuts the jets). With Flight also owned, it leaves a trail of fire.

H: vent every degree of heat at once as a rolling ring of fire — radius 4 + 6 x heat, damage 8 + 24 x heat (+ Nether / Flame Body bonuses), knockback and 5s of burning — leaving you stone cold and ending an overheat. Needs at least 10% heat. 10s cooldown.
N: crack a 9-block lash of living flame that uncurls in an S along your aim — everything it touches takes 11 fire damage (x heat), burns for 4s and is yanked toward you. +7 heat. 2.6s cooldown.

R: hurl a ghast fireball that explodes and scatters fire — a direct hit deals 14 fire damage (x heat, +5 in the Nether, +10 in Flame Body). +9 heat. Above 75% heat it becomes a Flame Laser instead: an instant 40-block beam of blue fire for 22 (x heat) around where it lands, with a blocks-only blast. +12 heat. 1.7s cooldown.

G: hold to pour a 7-block stream of flame — 7 fire damage a hit (x heat) and 4s of burning to everything in the cone, setting the surfaces it washes over alight. Builds heat steadily (~14s from cold to overheat); cuts out if you overheat.

Z: hold for 4.25s to charge (the fireball swells over your head), then loose a colossal flying fireball — a huge blast, and an afterburn of 14 fire damage (x heat) and 7s of burning within 5.5 blocks of where it bursts. Loosed above 75% heat it is a blue inferno with a bigger blast. +30 heat. 47s cooldown.

V: a flint-and-steel in your hand — light fires, TNT, campfires and nether portals where you look. Sneak + V pulls in every fire within 5 blocks (each one stokes your heat), cooks every raw item in your hand at once and turns held logs into coal blocks, planks into charcoal. 1s cooldown.

C: wreathe yourself in living flame — an emissive fire body that shifts from orange to white-gold to blue as your heat climbs. +10 ability damage, +8 melee (+5 more in the Nether), melee hits and attackers catch fire, everything within 3 blocks (4 when blue) is set alight, and your heat never drops below half. Blue: anything you have set burning within 24 blocks takes extra fire damage. 20s cooldown once dropped.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.p: Complete fire immunity — you are never set alight, even by your own flames; your Heat bar cools on its own when you stop channelling.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.d: Frost stacks, then frozen solid: every Cryokinesis hit adds frost stacks to its target (shown as creeping frost and a ring of snowflakes). At 5 stacks the target is frozen solid — sealed in a shell of ice and pinned in place for 3s (1.5s for players), unable to move, jump or strike, and the freeze shatters for 6. Stacks fade one at a time after 3s without a new one.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.t: Drink the serum and stay sunk in Powder Snow for a few seconds — or activate a Crystal Test Chamber.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.a: H: an instant cold snap 8 blocks around you — exposed water freezes to ice and lava to obsidian for 20s, every fire goes out (yours and your squad's burning too), and every creature caught takes 5 and two frost stacks. 12s cooldown.

N: conjure a sword of ice into your hand (whatever you held moves to a free slot) — 10 attack damage and a frost stack per hit. It melts after 30s, or the instant it leaves your hand; it can never be stored, dropped or kept. Press N again to shatter it early. 32s cooldown.

R: a bolt of frost — 8.5 damage (+10 in a cold biome or snow, +10 in Frozen Armor), a frost stack and brief slowness. 1.7s cooldown. Sneak + R opens a weapon wheel to shape the ice tool of your choice: iron mining level, 32 uses.

G: hold a freezing beam (16 blocks) — 6 damage and a frost stack every half second, heavy slowness, and it snuffs fire, turns lava it washes over to obsidian (cobblestone if flowing) and lays powder snow where it lands. The beam chills you too: a frostbite gauge (575) fills in ~5s and forces it off until it thaws.

X: the Iceman slide — a 3x3 platform of packed ice forms under you wherever you go (over air and water too) and you skate 150% faster. Look up while moving and the ice builds into a rising ramp; tap Sneak to drop a level. No fall damage while sliding. Toggle.

Z: hold for 4.25s to charge (snow swirls up around you), then a 20-block flash-freeze for 42 damage that freezes every target solid at once, blankets the area in snow and sheets water with ice. 38s cooldown.

V: raise a curved glacier wall — a 7-wide arc of packed ice three high, crested with blue ice, bowed around you 3.5 blocks out — for 15s; anything where it rises is shoved away and takes a frost stack. Sneak + V: a field of jagged ice spikes ahead (10 damage, 2 frost stacks, tossed into the air). 7s cooldown.

C: toggle thick frost plating with icicles at the shoulders and spine — Resistance I, knockback resistance, +10 ability damage, +8 melee; everything within 4 blocks takes a frost stack every 2s, anything that strikes you takes one, water you walk over freezes and snow dusts the ground. Drains a cold reserve (575, ~35s); 20s cooldown once dropped.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.p: Walk on powder snow with no leather boots, and move through a drift at full speed instead of wading
Immune to freezing damage; your own cold never builds up on you
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.a: Hurl everything orbiting you at the crosshair at once, each object hitting 20% harder than a single throw. 30 Psi, 3s cooldown.

Seize the creature you are aiming at (50 blocks) and freeze it in mid-air, 1.5 blocks up, for 4 seconds -- it cannot move, attack or target anything, and drifts down safely afterwards. No bosses. 90 Psi, 12s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.p: Up to three grabbed objects orbit you at once; they cost Psi to hold and fall gently if you burn out
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.d: Psionic force manipulation built around juggling: pull creatures, loose items and torn-up blocks into an orbit around you -- up to three at once -- then fling them one at a time or all together. Everything is paid for out of one Psi reserve; empty it and the power shuts down for ten seconds.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.t: Drink the serum near an Enchanting Table ringed by 8+ bookshelves, or activate an Enchanting Resonance Array.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.a: 12 damage and a hard shove to the entity you are aiming at (50 blocks), plus anything within 3 blocks of it. 0.85s cooldown, 35 Psi. Sneak for Force Pull instead: reels in a target and every loose item within 50 blocks (25 Psi).
A toggled shell of pure force. Nothing gets through while it holds -- but it burns 1.6 Psi a tick, and every blow it eats costs 4 Psi per point of damage. Break your reserve on it and you burn out.
Toggle telekinetic flight. A low, steady Psi drain (0.4 a tick) that stops at a safety floor instead of emptying you mid-air; what you juggle while flying is what costs.

Hold Z for 5s: everything within 50 blocks is torn off the ground and hauled toward you, held at arm’s length, then blown apart for 66 damage. 76s cooldown, 320 Psi, and your reserve crawls back at a fifth of its speed for 10s afterwards.

Pull the creature or dropped item under your crosshair (50 blocks) into your orbit -- up to 3 objects circle you at chest height (55 Psi a creature, 20 an item, plus 0.45 Psi a tick each while they orbit). Hold to lift a block up to 50 blocks away and steer it with your crosshair; release to throw it. A quick tap instead plucks the block straight into your orbit. Sneak to tear a 3x3 chunk out of the ground -- a thrown chunk hits the first creature it reaches for 31.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.p: Nearby dropped items drift slightly toward you while charged

projecthero.power.power_11_teleportation: Vanish and reappear behind the creature you are aiming at (30 blocks) with a strike for 11, then keep teleporting: every 0.3s you hop behind the nearest new enemy within 10 blocks and hit it too, up to 4 targets in all. Every hop is checked for a safe landing. 12s cooldown.
Trade places with the creature you are aiming at (40 blocks) -- or a squadmate. Only happens if both spots are safe for both bodies; an enemy arrives briefly disoriented. No bosses. 6s cooldown.

Short-range spatial distortion: combat blinks, a chaining Bamf Strike, place-swapping, marks, limited wall phasing, and linked portal gateways that can cross dimensions. Every jump leaves a puff of purple smoke and a fading afterimage where you stood.
Drink the serum and throw an Ender Pearl while the effect is active, or activate an Enchanting Resonance Array.
Hold to paint the destination (up to 75 blocks), release to teleport there, stopping safely before invalid blocks. Sneak instead for a Phase Jump straight through a thin wall. 2.5s cooldown.
Teleport to a safe spot behind the creature you are aiming at (50 blocks), turned to face it. 6s cooldown.
Instant teleport up to 9.5 blocks backward from your facing, with a moment of heavy damage resistance on arrival. 3.4s cooldown.

Hold for 5 seconds to charge (a bar shows the charge), then pick an exact destination -- coordinates and dimension -- in a screen. A linked pair of gateways forms slowly out of particles: one where you stand, one at the destination. Step into either to travel to the other. The pair stays open until you sneak + right-click a gate to close it, or you lose the power. 51s cooldown.

Place one return marker; activate again to return if the spot is still valid. Works across dimensions — a marker set in the Nether always brings you back to the Nether, wherever you press the key. 17s cooldown after a recall.

Press to place anchor A on the block you are looking at, press again for anchor B. The two link into a permanent portal that works across dimensions -- anyone who steps into one end comes out the other. Sneak + right-click either end to remove the pair; they also vanish if you lose the power.
message.projecthero.teleport.anchor_full: Both portal anchors are placed (sneak + right-click one to remove)
projecthero.power.power_12_super_regener: Super Regeneration

Aggressive cellular regeneration fuelled by Adrenaline: fast passive healing that never slows down, and every hit you take pumps you up for the next burst. Ascends into Wolverine with an Adamantium Serum.
Cellular Regeneration Serum
While the serum is active, survive being reduced below 3 hearts without dying.
Rapid Heal
R: instantly restore 7.2 health — 13.2 if you spend 20 Adrenaline. 5.1s cooldown.
Purge
G: burn every harmful effect out of your blood (the unstable mutation is not a poison — it stays). 10.2s cooldown.
Resurrection
Z (automatic): dying triggers full totem-of-undying protection — the unstable mutation survives it — and tops your Adrenaline off, then a 51s cooldown. Nothing to press.
Cellular Surge
V: an extra 2 HP every 0.25s (8 HP/s) for 30 seconds on top of your regeneration, plus a movement and mining boost; green veins glow bright under your skin. 38s cooldown.
Regeneration Mode
C: toggle an extra 1 HP every 0.25s; the only Super Regeneration ability that burns hunger (saturation every 5s). Green veins pulse under your skin while it runs.
Adrenal Rush
X: a lunge forward and 6s of Speed II and Jump Boost II; spend 25 Adrenaline and it is Speed III plus Resistance I. 8.5s cooldown.
Blood Rage
H: pour all your Adrenaline (at least 40) into 10s of fury: melee +25%, climbing to +100% the closer to death you are. 20s cooldown.
Mend

N: close the wounds of everyone you protect within 8 blocks — squad-mates, your tamed pets, villagers and iron golems: 8 health each, or 12 plus Regeneration I for 5s if you spend 20 Adrenaline. 12s cooldown.
Adrenaline (0–115): taking damage fills it (4 per point of damage taken); it drains slowly once you are out of combat
Passive regeneration: a steady 4 HP/s, in combat or not — it never slows down and hunger never stops it
Poison, Wither, Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Nausea and Hunger last only half as long
projecthero.power.power_13_super_durabil: Super Durability
A tank mutation that hardens the body against damage, knockback, projectiles and explosions — and banks everything it stops as Impact to hit back with.
Dermal Reinforcement Serum
Drink the serum and survive an explosion (TNT, a creeper) or activate a Controlled Blast Chamber.
Heavy Strike
R: a reinforced blow for 12 damage that staggers (Slowness IV for 2s). 2.5s cooldown.
Shoulder Charge
G: barrel forward through enemies — 10 damage and a hard shove to each. 6.8s cooldown.
Block
X: hold to cut damage from the frontal 180° arc by a further 60% and shrug off projectiles entirely; drains the guard bar.
Unbreakable
Z: ignore 100% of all damage for 15 seconds — and all of it is banked as Impact. Your plating turns to gleaming gold. 42.5s cooldown.
Deflection
V: hold to send every projectile that comes within 3.5 blocks straight back at whoever fired it, faster than it came (and it counts as yours); immune to projectiles while held. Drains the guard bar.
Tank Mode
C: toggle a braced stance: a further 30% damage reduction and knockback resistance, 30% slower. A thin metal shell covers your skin.
Impact Release
H: slam everything you have absorbed back out through the ground: 8 damage plus 0.3 per point of Impact (up to 42.5) in a 4–8 block radius, with knockback. Needs at least 20 Impact. 8s cooldown.
Taunt
N: every mob within 16 blocks turns on you, and you brace with Resistance I for 6s. 15s cooldown.
Impact (0–115): every point of damage your durability stops is banked, 3 per point — Unbreakable, Block and Deflection included. The guard bar is 575.
40% less damage from all sources, with 70% less fall damage and heavy explosion resistance
14 hearts of base health and 85% knockback resistance
Sonic Scream
Manipulate destructive sound. Every scream spends Voice and travels as visible rings of sound.
Resonance Serum
Blow a Goat Horn while the serum is active, or activate a Resonant Chamber.
Sonic Blast
A 5-block cone of sound for 12 damage with knockback and a brief stun. 16 Voice, 4.25s cooldown.
Focused Scream
A 30-block beam of sound for 19 damage with knockback, nausea and a brief stun. 24 Voice, 8.5s cooldown.
Sonic Jump

Blast the ground away beneath you to launch high into the air (4 damage and a shove to anything within 3 blocks) — and take no fall damage from the landing. Boosts an open elytra instead. 12 Voice, 4.25s cooldown.
Supersonic Scream

Hold Z for about 4 seconds as the sound builds in your throat, then unleash a 20-block cone of sound for 60 damage with severe knockback, nausea and a stun, shattering glass, ice and leaves along the way (terrain damage on). Start the hold while sneaking to scream all round you instead: 48 damage in a 20-block radius (68s cooldown). 55 Voice, 60s cooldown.
Resonance

Vibrate a spot up to 14 blocks away: glass, ice, leaves and other fragile blocks in a 3x3x3 shatter (terrain damage on), and anything within 3.5 blocks takes 6 damage and is stunned and nauseous for 2–3s. 18 Voice, 4.25s cooldown.
Echolocation

Toggle: a sonar ping every 2 seconds (4 Voice each) and pale rings of sound around your head — everything living within 20 blocks glows through walls for you alone, and your screams reach 30% further. Pings don’t stop your Voice recovering. Ends when Voice runs dry.
Sound Barrier

Raise a 5-wide, 3.5-tall wall of sound 3 blocks in front of you for 5 seconds: projectiles that fly into it are shredded, and enemies caught in it take 3 damage every half second and are shoved out. 30 Voice, 12s cooldown.
Disorient
A warbling pulse: everything within 10 blocks takes 4 damage, is slowed and nauseous for 6 seconds, and every mob forgets who it was fighting for 3 seconds. 20 Voice, 12s cooldown.

Greatly reduced self-damage from sonic effects. Enhanced hearing: anything living within 40 blocks flashes for you alone the instant it moves. Shift + right-click makes everything within 20 blocks glow for you alone for a few seconds.
Voice (115), always shown: every scream spends it, and it recovers 16 per second once you have been quiet for 1.5s.
projecthero.power.power_15_invisibility_: Invisibility / Light Manipulation
Hard-Light Blade

Conjure a glowing sword of solid light straight into your hand for 30 seconds: 9 damage, makes whatever it hits glow, never wears out. It is light, not an item -- switch away from it, drop it, open a container or let the 30 seconds run out and it is gone. Press again to dismiss it early. 20s cooldown once it fades.
Prism Shield

Hold to raise a pane of refracted light in front of you: arrows, fireballs and other projectiles coming at your front are bounced back at whoever shot them, and beams or ranged hits from the front are refracted away and 60% of them sent back at the sender. Melee still gets through. You move 35% slower while holding it; it drains its own 115-point Prism bar (and more per reflection), which refills when lowered.
Your cloak hides your held items and armour from everyone; Mirror Images and the Hard-Light Blade are pure light and can never be looted or kept

Bend light: refract yourself into decoys and prisms, vanish completely, conjure a blade of solid light, and burn enemies with blasts, flashes and pillars of holy light. Stronger and longer-ranged in direct sunlight.
Photonic Refraction Serum
Drink under direct sunlight with an unobstructed sky for several seconds.
Light Blast

Fired from your hand for 10 damage and 4s blindness, 0.85s cooldown. Hold to charge: +7 damage and +0.85s cooldown per second held (max 3s). Shift for a 5-blast volley, half a second apart (9.4s cooldown).
Flash

A searing burst of light around you (8 blocks): 12 damage, 10s blindness and Slowness II, and every mob caught loses track of you. 8.5s cooldown. Shift for Radiant Lance: a piercing line of light (30 blocks) that hits everything along it for 24, blinds, makes them glow and bursts at its far end (10s cooldown).
Sparkling Flight
Hold to fly wherever you look; your body scatters into light while it lasts. Drains the sparkle meter (115, ~29s), which refills on its own. 2.5s cooldown once you land.
Holy Light
Hold for 5 seconds to charge, then channel a single blinding pillar of light for 3 seconds — 14 continuous beam damage plus a radiant 29-damage burst every half second where it lands. 64s cooldown.
Mirror Images

Refract yourself: 2 Mirror Images (3 in direct sunlight) step out of you wearing your face, skin and gear, and scatter. For a second you vanish while every mob hunting you turns on an image instead -- and they keep luring nearby hostiles for 10 seconds. Any hit bursts an image into light that blinds whoever struck it. 16s cooldown.
Cloak
Sustained full invisibility — your armour and whatever you hold vanish too, for every player watching. Attacking reveals you for 2 seconds.
Reduced detection range while crouching. Always-on night vision. +10% ability damage and +20% range in direct sunlight.
projecthero.power.power_16_spider_climbi: Spider Climbing / Adhesion

Cling to any surface and move across it. Turn the grip on, then double-tap jump against a wall or ceiling to grab it -- climb up, crawl sideways, hang still, and double-tap sneak (or jump) to let go. A predator's kit on top: sticky strikes, pounces, a spider-sense that side-steps the next attack and a venomous bite. Slower and less sure-footed than the arachnid who evolves out of it.
Adhesive Mutation Serum
Get hit by a Cave Spider while the serum is active and survive the poison.
Adhesive Strike
A sticky palm strike (4.5-block reach): 8.5 damage and the target is glued in place -- rooted and weakened for 7 seconds. 3.4s cooldown.
Pounce
A predatory leap along your aim. The first enemy you land on within 1.5 seconds takes 7 damage and is slowed. No fall damage from the leap. 4.25s cooldown.
Wall Leap
Powerfully launch away from the surface you are gripping (or kick off backwards in mid-air). 2.55s cooldown.
Predator Rush
35 seconds of the hunt: Speed II, Haste II, Jump Boost III and Strength, with your eyes glowing red. 30s cooldown.
Wall Grip

Arm the grip. With it on, double-tap jump against a wall or ceiling to stick, then look where you want to go and move relative to the surface. Stop and you stay put; sneak and you hold tighter. Double-tap sneak, or reach the ground, to let go.
Adhesion Mode
The same grip, armed permanently -- double-tap jump against walls, overhangs and ceilings to hold them, double-tap sneak or jump to let go.
Reduced fall damage
Improved jump height
Spider-Sense Dodge

H: your spider-sense tingles for about a second -- the next attack that would hit you (melee or projectile) is dodged outright with a sidestep and a burst of speed. A red halo pulses over your head while it is primed. 6s cooldown.
Venom Bite
N: a lunging bite on whatever is in front of you (3.8 blocks): 7 damage, Poison II for 6 seconds and Slowness II for 4. A miss costs nothing. 7s cooldown.
Spider-sense: you see a faint red shimmer over every hostile creature nearby (brighter and wider while Spider-Sense Dodge is primed)
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.de: A rubber body: your arms visibly stretch across the battlefield to punch, grab and slingshot, you inflate into a projectile-bouncing balloon, flatten into a parachute, and shrug off falls entirely.
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.tr: While the serum is active, fall at least 10 blocks onto a Slime Block — or activate a Gravity Distortion Rig.
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.ab: Your arm shoots out (visibly stretching to the target, up to 15 blocks) for 14.5 damage. Hold to charge (a bar shows it): +6 damage per second, up to +12 at 2s, and 2 blocks more reach per second. Cooldown 1.7s, +0.85s for every second you hold it.
On the ground: both arms stretch 7 blocks out for a heavy forward smash, 20.5 damage in a 4-block ball. More than 5 blocks up: plunge straight down for a 24-damage ground pound. 6s cooldown.

Anchor and launch. Aimed at terrain your arm snaps to it and reels you in; aimed at a creature (45 blocks) your arm latches onto THEM, you are hauled in at speed, and slam into them for 17 damage. 2.55s cooldown.
Both arms stretch out and swell into giant fists that slam the aim point: 41 damage in a 4.5-block area, plus Slowness. 30s cooldown.
Your arm stretches out (15 blocks), wraps a mob or player and reels them in, holding them at arm's length for up to 6 seconds; press again to hurl them for 8.5 damage. 5.1s cooldown after a throw.

Toggle a body shape. All three shapes deflect projectiles outright. Plain C is Elastic: +reach, +speed, Jump Boost, +9.5 ability damage and +5 melee damage, a rubbery sheen, melee attackers bounce off, and while you hold the jump key your landings rebound like a slime block. Shift + C opens a wheel to switch to Inflated (wider, slower, Slowness II, -50% damage taken, 100% knockback resistance, attackers flung 10 blocks) or Compression (one block tall, +25% move speed).

H (hold): inflate into a rubber balloon. Every projectile that reaches you bounces straight back at whoever fired it, melee attackers are flung away, you take 65% less damage and cannot be knocked back -- but you move at half speed. Drains the Rubber bar (5 seconds from full, refills in ~9s). 8s cooldown once you let go.

N: flatten out into a canopy with your arms spread -- you fall slowly and glide forward wherever you look (look steeply down to dive faster). Used on the ground it hops you up first. Lasts up to 8 seconds, ends when you land, or press N again to fold up. 5s cooldown.

projecthero.power.power_18_density_manip: Density Manipulation

Dial your density anywhere from 25% to 300% -- lighter is faster, heavier hits harder and shrugs off blows -- phase through walls, flicker intangible, and crush your enemies under their own weight. A thin shell over your body glows blue when light and orange when heavy.
Molecular Density Serum
Activate a Molecular Compression Chamber while the serum is active.
Increase Density
Raise your density by 5% (up to 300%). Higher density: more damage dealt, less taken, more knockback resistance, but slower.
Decrease Density
Lower your density by 5% (down to 25%). Lower density: faster, but you deal less damage and take more -- and you lose the knockback resistance that higher density would give you.
Density Anchor
Slam to maximum density and root in place for 10s: cannot be moved by mobs, immune to knockback, 76% damage reduction, but cannot sprint or jump. A 25.5s cooldown starts when it ends.
Heavy Impact

More than 6 blocks up: slam straight down for up to 54 damage in a 20-block radius (falls off with distance) and shatter some ground. On the ground: launch upward, then slam -- the rise only ever lasts 3 seconds before the slam forces itself, so you are never left stranded in the sky. 8.5s cooldown.
Zero Density
Drop straight to 25% density -- maximum speed, minimum weight. 1.7s cooldown.
Phase

Toggle: vibrate and walk straight through solid blocks while the Phase meter lasts (115, 15% bigger than before). You are immune to all damage while phasing, and you render see-through so everyone can tell. This is intangibility, not flight -- you cannot rise more than 2 blocks above the ground beneath you. Jump to rise, sneak to sink; your head buried in a block costs air.
Your density (25%-300%) sets your speed, damage dealt, damage taken and knockback -- shown on the HUD
Intangible Dodge
H: flicker intangible for half a second with a short dash -- every attack, projectile and blast passes straight through you. A cyan shimmer shows it. 4s cooldown.
Crushing Touch

N: charge your fist (it glows orange) for up to 8 seconds. The next creature you hit becomes super-dense for 5 seconds: 70% slower, unable to jump, triple gravity, and anything flying is dragged out of the sky. 12s cooldown.
A thin shell over your body shows your density: blue when you are light, orange when you are heavy
projecthero.power.power_19_shadow_manipu: Shadow Manipulation
Shadow Bind

Black chains erupt from the ground around the creature you are aiming at (24 blocks) and up to 2 others beside it: 9 damage, rooted in place, weakened and briefly blinded for 5 seconds (longer in the Deep Dark, shorter in light). 10s cooldown. Shift for Shadow Grab: seize a target up to 20 blocks away and hold it; press again to throw, or Shift to set it down.
Shadow Walk

Sink into the ground as a moving puddle of shadow: invisible (armour and held items too), Speed III, no fall damage and half damage from everything, and every mob loses track of you -- but you cannot attack, and using an attack ability surfaces you. Drains its own 115-point bar (~10 seconds in darkness, twice as fast in bright light), which refills when you surface.
Shadow Servant

Raise a silhouette of living darkness with glowing eyes that fights for you for 20 seconds: 30 health, 8 damage a hit (scaled by the light), and it goes for whatever hurt you, whatever you are fighting, or the nearest hostile. It never targets you, your squad or your pets. One at a time. 30s cooldown.
Shadow Walk and Shadow Step let you travel through darkness itself; the Shadow Servant never turns on you or your squad

Darkness as a resource and a road: bolts, tendrils, binding chains, a shadow servant, and travel through the shadows themselves -- step through darkness or sink into a moving puddle of it. Everything is stronger in the dark and weaker in sunlight.
Umbral Serum
Drink at night while standing in true darkness (light level 0) for several seconds.
Shadow Bolt
Fire a dark-energy bolt for 13 damage that blinds the target for 4 seconds (1.7s cooldown). Shift for a 5-bolt fan volley (12.75s cooldown).
Shadow Tendrils

Lash nearby enemies with tendrils from the ground for 18 damage and blind them for 8 seconds (6.8s cooldown). Shift for a 10-block cone that also roots everything it hits in place for 8 seconds (17s cooldown).
Shadow Step
Blink up to 75 blocks through darkness, hitting anything at the landing spot for 6 (2.5s cooldown). Out of darkness you need Shift to seek out a dark spot to land in instead (6.8s cooldown).
Shadow Zone
Hold for 5 seconds to charge, then unleash a 20-block shadow zone: everything caught sinks, slows, blinds and takes 10 damage a second for 11 seconds. 51s cooldown.
Shadow Form

Become a thick black silhouette with burning purple eyes. Toggle for Shadow Cloak: +12 ability damage, +8 melee damage and a slowing, blinding aura, draining a 115-point bar (~40 seconds) and ending on a 17s cooldown. Shift+toggle instead for the indefinite stealth Shadow Form: in darkness you turn invisible, fast, and mobs lose track of you.
Every ability scales with ambient light: 50% in bright light, 75% indoors, 100% in darkness, 130% in the Deep Dark. Always-on night vision.

projecthero.power.power_20_energy_absorp: Energy Absorption
Absorb fire, lightning, explosions and magic — and release them again as the same element.
Energy Conversion Serum
While the serum is active, survive two different kinds of energy (fire, explosion, lightning) — or activate a Controlled Blast Chamber.
Energy Blast
Spend 10 energy on a 16-damage bolt of your stored element, 1.7s cooldown. Hold to charge: +6 damage and +1.7s cooldown per second held, up to 3s.
Energy Beam

Hold for a sustained beam of your element: 11 damage a hit and the element’s effect every half second, draining 20 energy/s; 4.25s cooldown on release. Shift for an 18-damage burst in 9 blocks instead (50 energy, 17s cooldown).
Energy Dash
Dash forward on a trail of your element, hitting anything in the first few blocks for 7 damage and the element’s effect. 5 energy, 1.7s cooldown.
Overload

Hold Z for 3.5 seconds as a ball of your element grows overhead, then release the WHOLE meter at once (at least 100): 25 damage + 1 per 10 energy spent, in a 6–11-block radius that grows with the energy, with the element’s effect on everything hit and a crater when terrain damage is on. 25s cooldown.
Energy Drain

Hold on a creature within 12 blocks: every half second it takes 5 magic damage and you take 14 energy and 1 health. Aim at a redstone block, ore, lamp or lightning rod to drink its current instead (10 energy, as lightning). Up to 6s, 8s cooldown. Shift + V instead converts 10 energy into 2 health every half second.
Absorption Mode

Toggle: a glowing lattice shell in your element’s colour. Soak 80% of elemental and 40% of physical damage (up from 60% / 25%), +10 ability damage, +8 melee, Speed II and Haste II; your punches glow with your element. 7 energy/s; 17s cooldown when it ends.
Redirect

For 3 seconds the next projectile flying at you is caught and thrown back at whoever fired it, and a melee blow is negated and fired back at the attacker for 1.5x its damage + 6 with your element’s effect. Half the caught damage becomes energy. 25 energy, 10s cooldown.
Empower

Spend 100 energy on a 12-second buff that depends on the stored element: Fire — Strength and Fire Resistance; Lightning — Speed II and Haste II; Explosion — Resistance II; Magic — Regeneration II and Absorption II; raw — Strength and Speed. Your punches carry the element while it lasts. 25s cooldown.

575-point Energy meter, always shown and coloured by its element: fire orange, lightning blue, explosion yellow, magic purple, raw cyan. Trickle-regenerates to 25% after 10s without absorbing. 80% grants Strength and Speed; a full meter slowly hurts you. Redstone charges it as lightning (stand on it, harvest dust, or Sneak + use a block or dust to burn it).

Fire, lightning, explosion and magic damage: 60% is soaked into the meter and sets its element. Other hits: 25% soaked, element unchanged. Everything you fire comes out as the element — fire ignites, lightning arcs to a second target and stuns, explosion blows the target away, magic withers and weakens.
projecthero.power.power_21_shockwave_man: Shockwave Manipulation
Store kinetic force — the blows, falls and blasts you take — and release it as pressure waves.
Kinetic Amplification Serum
Drink the serum and survive an explosion (TNT, a creeper) or activate a Controlled Blast Chamber.
Shockwave Punch
A 7-block pressure cone for 12 damage with knockback, trailing distortion rings. Spends up to 10 Kinetic for up to x1.5 damage and knockback. 1.7s cooldown.
Ground Wave

A shockwave that races about 20 blocks along the ground (2-block step assist) for 16 damage to everything it passes, throwing it up. Shift + G bursts all round you instead: 18 damage in 8 blocks (6s cooldown). Spends up to 15 Kinetic for up to x1.5 damage. 5s cooldown.
Recoil Jump
Blast yourself up and forward like a super-leap — no fall damage on landing. With 10+ Kinetic it spends 10 for a 30% bigger jump and a 6-damage blast on the spot you left. 2.5s cooldown.
Kinetic Detonation
Hold for about 4 seconds with a full Kinetic gauge to release a 20-block shockwave for 72 damage, launching everything. Spends the whole gauge, 85s cooldown.
Repulsion Field
Hold to keep a 3-block field of force up: enemies are shoved away, projectiles thrown back, and damage you take is cut by 30%. Drains 6 Kinetic/s.
Charge
Hold to brace: bank 5 Kinetic/s, and every blow, fall or blast you take while bracing stores double and hurts less (melee 40% off). 4.25s cooldown once released.
Aftershock

A delayed second wave where your last wave landed (within 12s and 48 blocks): rings tighten on the spot for 0.8s, then it erupts for 14 damage in 5 blocks and launches everything up. Spends up to 15 Kinetic for up to x1.5. 8s cooldown.
Kinetic Parry

Open a 0.7s parry window: the next melee hit is negated, stored at double its damage, and the attacker takes 5 damage and is thrown back and slowed. A successful parry cuts the cooldown to 2s. 6s cooldown.
70% less knockback taken; immune to your own shockwaves.

Kinetic storage (a gauge of 115, always shown): melee hits you take are 15% dampened and banked, falls 40% dampened and banked at 1.2x, explosions halved and banked at 1.5x. Only kinetic force — never fire, lightning or magic.
projecthero.power.power_22_plant_manipul: Plant Manipulation / Chlorokinesis
Command growth itself: thorns, snaring vines, living walls, explosive overgrowth, a planted thorn turret that fights for you and healing spore clouds -- all stronger on living ground.
Chlorokinetic Serum
Drink beneath open sky while surrounded by natural plant blocks, flowers or saplings.
Thorn Shot

Fired from your hand for 9.5 damage and Poison III for 8 seconds (1.7s cooldown). Shift, while on natural ground or holding bone meal/a sapling, for Branch Thrust: a 15-block lunge dealing 18 damage with a trail of logs that grows into a tree (8.5s cooldown).
Thorn Snare
Root a target for 8 seconds with a lashing vine, 3.6 damage. Shift for a 10-block cone that snares every enemy in front of you. 6s cooldown.
Vine Swing
Attach a vine line to a block up to 100 blocks away and swing toward it (no fall damage for 10s) -- or, aimed at a target instead, pull them to you. 0.85s cooldown.
Overgrowth

Hold for 5 seconds to charge (roots gather, your eyes glow green), then explosive growth in a 20-block radius: 54 damage, rooted and Poison X for 10 seconds, and a dense thicket that recedes after a few seconds. 51s cooldown.
Living Wall
Conjure a wall of leaves -- look up for a dome, look down for a bridge. Sneak instead to charge your touch with bone meal for 30 seconds. 6.8s cooldown.
Nature’s Blessing

Toggle: your skin turns to bark and leaves. While standing on grass/moss or within 5 blocks of any plant or leaf, gain Regeneration II and +12 to all ability and melee damage. Enemies within 3 blocks of you are poisoned.
Right-clicking any growable plant bone-meals it twice. Plants within 30 blocks grow roughly 50% faster.
Minor regeneration in lush areas. Standing on or against grass/dirt/moss grants Regeneration, Haste, Resistance and Strength.
Attacks and interactions pass straight through short grass, ferns, tall grass and dead bushes instead of being blocked by them.
Thorn Sentry

H: plant a living turret of cactus and flowering azalea where you look (up to 6 blocks). For 15 seconds it turns to the nearest hostile it can see within 14 blocks and spits thorns at it twice a second -- 5 damage and a short Poison each. It never targets you, your squad or any player. One at a time: a new one replaces the old. 25s cooldown.
Spore Cloud

N: breathe out a 4.5-block cloud of spores just ahead of you for 8 seconds. Every half second, enemies inside are poisoned and blinded while you and your squad-mates inside are healed and given Regeneration. 16s cooldown.
message.projecthero.plant.need_nature: You need to be on natural ground, or holding bone meal or a sapling
projecthero.power.power_23_gravity_manip: Gravity Manipulation
Invert

Flip gravity on the creature you are aiming at (30 blocks): it falls UP into the sky for 1.5 seconds (taking 6 if it hits a ceiling), then gravity slams back doubled -- it crashes down for 10 plus fall damage, and everything within 3 blocks of the impact takes 5. No bosses. 9s cooldown.
Heavy Ground

Crush gravity onto a 7-block circle where you aim (24 blocks) for 8 seconds: nothing inside can jump, everything is slowed and takes 3 damage a second, and anything in the air above it -- flying mobs included, up to 14 blocks up -- is dragged down to the floor. Never affects you or your squad. 17s cooldown.
Decide which way gravity pulls: push, crush and levitate, flip a target so it falls into the sky, pin a whole area to the floor, and tear open a black hole.
Gravitic Distortion Serum
Drink the serum, then activate a Gravity Distortion Rig, an Unstable Gravity Plate or a Pressure Chamber — or survive a fall of 14+ blocks.
Gravity Push
A focused gravity pulse, 50-block range, that throws targets away for 12 damage, 1.7s cooldown. Shift for a grab instead — press again to throw for 10.
Gravity Crush

Hold to crush a target up to 50 blocks away for up to 8 seconds, no knockback — 5 damage a second and Slowness II. 17s cooldown on release. Shift for a separate, smaller Gravity Well 20 blocks out (2.5 damage a second, 6 seconds).
Zero-G
Toggle 85% lighter personal gravity for floating and aerial repositioning (no fall damage while it is on). Shift+toggle also fires Gravity Repulsion, pushing nearby enemies away (8.5s cooldown).
Black Hole

Hold for 5 seconds to charge, then rip open a black hole 5 blocks ahead: pulls everything within 30 blocks in, 7 damage a second inside 10 blocks, destroys terrain, lasts 15 seconds. Never affects you or your squad. 102s cooldown.
Gravity Lift

Mark up to 10 targets within 20 blocks with Levitation, capped 10 blocks up, for 20 seconds -- free, no cooldown. Shift to slam every marked target down for 17 damage plus fall damage; only the slam pays the 21s cooldown.
Gravitational Nexus

Toggle a gravitational-pressure stance wrapped in a thin violet field: +12 ability damage, +8 melee damage, Speed II and Resistance I, while everything within 3 blocks of you takes Slowness IV and 2.5 damage a second. Drains a 115-point bar (~40 seconds); ends on a 17s cooldown.
80% less fall damage, 50% less knockback taken, unaffected by your own gravity effects
message.projecthero.gravity.nexus_low: Your gravitational reserve is too depleted
projecthero.power.power_24_wind_manipula: Wind Manipulation
Ride the air: glide on currents, raise updrafts, and throw blades, gusts and storms.
Atmospheric Pressure Serum
Drink inside an active Pressure Chamber / Industrial Fan Array.
Wind Blade
A crescent of air: 10 damage at up to 26 blocks, 1.7s cooldown. Sneak + hold R about 1.7s: a wide blade that pierces every enemy in a 6-wide corridor for 19 damage (19s cooldown).
Wind Burst
A 6-block cone of pressure for 14 damage that hurls enemies away and turns projectiles around. 8.5s cooldown.
Wind Flight
Use controlled air currents for limited flight/propulsion.
Hurricane
Hold Z for about 4 seconds to charge, then an 11-second storm around you — 10 damage a second in a 15-block radius, everything whirled around, projectiles thrown back. 51s cooldown.
Wind Push
A wall of air that hurls everything in front of you far away and turns projectiles back. 3.4s cooldown.
Tailwind

Toggle a supporting current: Speed II, high jumps, a 2-block step, +10 ability damage, +8 melee, faster glides, and a gust that shoves anything within 2 blocks away — with a pale air shell while it runs. Drains Wind over ~20s; 20s cooldown when it ends.
Glide / Updraft

On the ground: raise an updraft that throws you up (50 Wind, 5s cooldown) — for 12s anyone gliding through or over it keeps climbing (up to three at once). In the air: start or stop gliding. Sprint-jumping off a ledge also starts a glide. Steer by looking, look down to dive, Sneak to drop out; no fall damage from a glide.
Rideable Tornado

Summon a tornado under you and ride it for 12 seconds: it follows your look, hugs the ground and water, drags every enemy within 8 blocks into a spiral and grinds those at its core for 4 damage a second. Press H again (or Sneak) to get off — no fall damage. 120 Wind, 30s cooldown.
Vacuum

Rip the air out of a spot 4 blocks ahead for 2 seconds: every enemy within 12 blocks is dragged in, and those near the centre suffocate for 2.5 damage every half second (ignores armour) and are slowed. 12s cooldown.
80% less fall damage (none out of a glide or off a tornado), 30% faster sprint, a 3-block jump, sneak-fall drifting, rocket-free elytra boosts, and you drown 50% slower
A 575-point Wind reserve, always shown. Sprint-jump off anything with 3+ blocks of air below to glide; updrafts lift gliders; a thin pale air shell shows while you glide, ride or run Tailwind.
projecthero.power.power_25_water_manipul: Water Manipulation

A carried water supply: the Water bar (575) fuels every move and nothing refills it for free — stand in water (fast), in rain (slowly), right-click a water bottle (+20%) or Sneak + right-click a water bucket (+50%); a trickle of moisture from the air refills it very slowly anywhere but the Nether. Aquatic Form halves every cost. Extremely capable underwater.
Hydrokinetic Serum
Drink the serum and stay fully underwater for 15 seconds (the serum keeps you breathing), or use a Hydrostatic Test Tank.
Healing Water

H: pour healing water over yourself and everyone on your side within 6 blocks — squadmates and your own tamed animals — for 6 health each, 5s of Regeneration I, and any fire put out. 120 water, 12s cooldown.
Geyser

N: a geyser erupts. Look at a creature (20 blocks) and it blasts up under them — 12 damage and a launch straight up, soaked. Look at nothing and it erupts under you, throwing you about 8 blocks up with 8s of no fall damage. 50 water, 7.5s cooldown.
Water Shot

R: a high-pressure jet for 10 damage (+5 wet, +10 in Aquatic Form) with knockback that puts out fire and soaks the target. 25 water, 1.7s cooldown. Sneak + hold R to spray a stream instead — 6 damage a hit, puts out fire and pushes, 2.5 water a tick.
Water Whip
G: a tendril of water uncurls from your hand along your aim (12 blocks), sways and snaps — everything it touches takes 19 and is hauled toward you, soaked. 40 water, 5.1s cooldown.
Riptide
X: fire yourself along a jet of water in a fast dash — further while wet — bowling over anything in the way (7 damage). Free in water or rain, otherwise 30 water. 5.1s cooldown.
Tidal Wave

Z: hold for 4.25s to gather a sphere of water, then send a wall of real water — 7 wide, 2 high — rolling 18 blocks out along your aim: 42 damage to everything it sweeps over, carrying them with it. The water only fills air and drains right behind the crest. 200 water, 38s cooldown.
Water Prison

V: seal a target in a shell of water for 8s — pinned in place, weakened, but not drowned; the water never spreads and drains the moment it ends. Press again to free them early. 60 water, 10.2s cooldown. Sneak + hold V for 4s to shape a temporary water source where you look (60s) — or right-click a water source while shaping to siphon it into your supply.
Aquatic Form
C: toggle a shimmering film of living water over your body — doubled water buffs, +10 ability damage, +8 melee, every water cost halved and the supply refills 50% faster. 20s cooldown once dropped.
Improved swimming
Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace always; Night Vision, extra speed and endless air while in water
Water supply: refills in water, in rain, from bottles and buckets, and very slowly from the air
projecthero.power.power_26_magnetic_mani: Magnetic Manipulation
Magneto Hover

Toggle: push off the metal around you and levitate -- fly freely while there is magnetic metal within a few blocks below or around you, or while you hold an iron item. Leave the metal behind and you drift down gently until you find more. Drains its own 115-point bar (~15 seconds), which refills when you land; field lines crackle over your body while it lifts you.
Disarm

Rip the iron or netherite weapon out of a creature's hand -- or, failing that, a piece of its armour -- and send it clattering to the ground toward you as a real item (4 damage as iron tears loose). Works on players only when PvP ability damage is allowed. Never touches Mjolnir, copper or gold; no metal means no cooldown. 10s cooldown.

Manipulate magnetically reactive metal for combat and movement. Your abilities require actual magnetic material in the environment or on your enemies -- ride it, rip it off them, or hurl it. Copper and gold are not magnetically reactive; netherite can be manipulated but strongly resists magnetic force.
Magnetoreactive Serum
Drink the serum and stand among 16+ iron or copper blocks, bars or anvils for a few seconds — or activate an Electromagnetic Coil.
Ferrous Shot

Launch a nearby magnetic object — a block you look at, a dropped metal item within 30 blocks, a nearby metal block, or (failing all else) a magnetic item from your own inventory — toward your crosshair. Heavier objects fly slower but hit far harder (iron nugget ~7, iron block ~22, anvil/netherite block ~34). 2.5s cooldown; fails with no cooldown if there is no magnetic metal anywhere in reach.
Magnetic Grip

Grab a magnetic block, dropped item, minecart or iron golem and float it on your aim. Heavier objects follow more sluggishly; netherite resists. Activate again to hurl it forward (1.25s between grips).
Polarity Leap

Pull yourself rapidly toward a magnetic object you are looking at, up to 24 blocks. Preserves momentum and cushions the landing briefly — chain leaps between metal to travel. 1.7s cooldown; fails with no cooldown if nothing magnetic is targeted.
Metal Storm

Gather up to 8 nearby magnetic objects into a violent orbit, then launch them at whatever you aim toward. Each object's damage scales with its mass (+20%); damage to any one target is capped at 36 so it can't instantly delete an enemy. Needs at least 2 magnetic objects nearby. 15s cooldown.
Magnetic Crush

Use the magnetic metal an enemy wears or holds against them — crushing damage that scales with how much they carry (one item ~8, full iron armour ~23), plus Slowness and Weakness, and a hard immobilise at 3+ pieces. Netherite takes less damage but is still locked down. No metal on the target means no effect and no cooldown. 7.6s cooldown.
Magnetic Sense

Toggle: highlight nearby magnetically reactive objects — iron blocks and ore, iron bars, chains, anvils, rails, lanterns, minecarts, lodestone, netherite, dropped iron, and metal-equipped enemies. Copper and gold are never highlighted.
Dropped magnetic items within 30 blocks drift toward you, hopping over ledges; controlled objects can't hurt you
Objects you are currently controlling never damage their owner
projecthero.power.power_27_size_manipula: Size Manipulation

Change body scale -- every change eases over a second -- for stealth, mobility or giant strength: shrink foes with a punch, ride mobs when tiny, and pick them up when huge. Neither form is universally superior.
Mass Compression Serum
Drink the serum, then activate a Mass Compression Chamber (found at Government Experiment Sites, or craft one).
Giant Punch
Enlarge the striking arm for a wide sweeping hit: 12 damage (+6 in Large, +18 in Giant, a third in Tiny) -- its reach scales with how big you are (roughly 4x in Giant form). 2.55s cooldown.
Stomp
Stomp for a ground shockwave: 9.6 damage (+6 Large, +18 Giant) and a slow, with a radius that scales with your size (much wider as a giant). 6.8s cooldown.
Tiny Form
Toggle (X): shrink to about half a block tall over one second, in a puff of particles. Press again to ease back to normal size.
Giant Form

Toggle (Z): grow to ~15 blocks tall over one second, in a burst of particles -- ~16-block reach, +18 damage on every move, 3-block leaps, and creatures you walk over are trampled. Drains the Size Strain bar (575, ~26s); once you shrink back it slowly recharges on its own.
Tiny Dash
Rapidly dash forward with a burst of speed and brief damage resistance -- duck under attacks or slip through a gap. 4.25s cooldown.
Large Form
Toggle (C): grow to about 6 blocks tall over one second, in a burst of particles -- ~7-block reach, +6 damage, a wide pickup radius, and 3-block leaps. Press again for normal size.
Form-dependent reach, speed, step height and hitbox changes
Every form takes 65% less fall damage
Shrink Punch

H: a punch that shrinks its target to half size for 8 seconds -- a smaller hitbox, shorter reach and 40% weaker hits -- plus 8 damage. Bosses take the hit but keep their size. A miss costs nothing. 10s cooldown.
Mount

N: in Tiny form, climb onto the mob you are looking at and ride it (up to 60 seconds). In Large or Giant form, pick up the mob you are looking at (anything under 60% of your height) and carry it in your hand for up to 20 seconds. Press N again to hop off or throw it. It is always let go safely if you change form, die or lose the power. 2s cooldown after.

projecthero.guide.overview.body: Project Hero turns Minecraft into a superhero sandbox. Alongside iconic heroes like Thor, Iron Man, Spider-Man, Max Steel, the Punisher, Green Lantern, Wolverine, the Titan Shifter, All Might, Moon Knight and the Hulk, you can undergo experimental mutations to permanently gain one of 27 minor powers, each with eight abilities on a shared control scheme.
projecthero.guide.powerclass.body: Every power is either Primary or Secondary. Primary powers are who you are: Thor, Iron Man, Spider-Man, Max Steel, the Punisher, Green Lantern, Wolverine, the Titan Shifter, All Might, the Hulk, Moon Knight and the 27 mutations. You hold ONE Primary power at a time (v0.14.4). The mutations count as one group that shares that single slot (up to 3 of them stack, as before). Gaining any hero power -- however you get it, lifting Mjolnir included -- replaces the hero power or mutations you had: become Spider-Man, then lift Mjolnir, and you are Thor and nothing else. Gaining a mutation replaces your hero power. Secondary powers ride on top of a Primary one. The Symbiote is the only Secondary power for now. It shares a host only with Spider-Man (Black Suit) or the Punisher (Agent Venom), so gaining any other Primary power also removes the Symbiote. Worlds saved under the old two-power rule keep only their newest hero power the next time you join.
projecthero.guide.controls.title: Controls
projecthero.guide.controls.body: Every power uses the same six ability keys, named Ability 1 to Ability 6 in Options > Controls (R, G, Z, X, C, V by default: Ability 1 = R, Ability 2 = G, Ability 3 = Z, Ability 4 = X, Ability 5 = C, Ability 6 = V). What each key does depends on your active power (or on Thor, when you hold Mjolnir). Two utility keys sit beside them: Utility 1 (H) and Utility 2 (N).
projecthero.guide.controls.select: H   Utility 1 - with a mutation selected, H is its Utility 1 ability and Shift+H opens the power wheel (switch which mutation occupies the keys). Hero powers use H first: Iron Man's faceplate, Max Steel's helmet, the Symbiote suit, the Hulk, Moon Knight's suit, Wolverine's claws, Thor's armour. Alt+H always fires your mutation's Utility 1.
projecthero.guide.controls.info: I   Your Power - open a quick reference for your active power and all of its abilities.
projecthero.guide.controls.squad: P   Squad - team roster: teammate health, powers, position and distance. See the Squads chapter.
projecthero.guide.mutation.body: 1. Study a research note to learn a mutation exists. 2. Craft the power’s reagent from obscure materials, then brew it with the listed base potion to make an unstable serum. 3. Drink the serum — you gain a temporary Unstable Mutation. 4. Before it fades, perform the required exposure event (a dangerous accident, or a laboratory device). 5. Survive it and the power is yours forever: UNUSUAL MUTATION DETECTED.
projecthero.guide.mutation.capacity: You may permanently own up to 3 minor mutations (server-configurable). Only one occupies the six ability slots at a time — switch with the power wheel (H). Switching never resets cooldowns or duplicates passives. The mutations share your single Primary slot: a serum adds a mutation to the ones you carry, but replaces any hero power you hold (and removes a bonded Symbiote). In the other direction, gaining any hero power replaces every mutation you carry. A Power Suppressor strips everything — every hero power, every mutation and a bonded Symbiote.
projecthero.guide.mutation.research: Research advances: Research Found → Serum Stabilized → Exposure Survived → Mutation Confirmed. Once confirmed, the full recipe is permanently recorded and reproducible for teammates.
projecthero.guide.structures.body: Seven rare structures generate above ground across the Overworld. Explore to find them; six hold research notes, thematic ingredients and usually a laboratory device, and the Gamma Lab holds the Gamma Serum.
projecthero.guide.structure.research_fac: Brewing gear, copper/redstone machinery and a light projector. Linked to Flight, Laser Vision, Telekinesis, Wind and Gravity research.
projecthero.guide.structure.meteor_impac: A scorched crater with an unusual central crystal. Linked to Energy Absorption, Flight, Laser Vision and Density.
projecthero.guide.structure.power_statio: Coils, generators and an Overloaded Redstone Coil. Linked to Electrokinesis, Super Speed, Super Strength and Magnetism.
projecthero.guide.structure.geological_s: Lapis, amethyst and resonance equipment. Linked to Geokinesis, Crystalkinesis and Density.
projecthero.guide.structure.government_s: A rare fenced compound with prototype compression machines. Linked to Density, Size and Gravity.
projecthero.guide.structure.hydrostatic_: A small pump station near water with a Hydrostatic Test Tank. Linked to Water Manipulation.
projecthero.guide.devices.body: Craftable, reusable devices that reliably trigger a specific exposure event. Most fire on a redstone pulse; some on right-click. Stand within a few blocks with an active serum.
projecthero.guide.combos.body: Owning two complementary powers unlocks synergies (they apply passively where relevant):
projecthero.guide.thor.body: Thor is a Primary power, rarer and stronger than any minor mutation -- Mjolnir does not drop from any mob or chest; you have to find a natural hammer and prove yourself worthy of it.
projecthero.guide.thor.step.find_hammer: Find a hammer -- hold a Lightning Rod and Sneak + right-click a villager; 25 emeralds buys a direction to the nearest free Mjolnir
projecthero.guide.thor.step.worthy: Become a Hero of the Village -- defeat a raid or a Supervillain Raid to earn the effect
projecthero.guide.thor.step.lift: Lift the hammer while Hero of the Village is active -- it binds to you instantly and the effect is used up
projecthero.guide.thor.bind: Binding makes Thor your one Primary power: every other hero power and any mutations you carry are replaced, and a bonded Symbiote is removed. It only ever happens at the moment of lifting -- once Hero of the Village runs out, an unbound hammer will not move for you again until you earn the effect again. Someone else who lifts a hammer already bound to another player may carry it while their own effect lasts, but it never binds to them and the owner is untouched. Once you are Thor you can pick up your own hammer freely, and Sneak + right-click still unbinds and rebinds it.
projecthero.guide.thor.perk.speed: +18% movement speed and some knockback resistance
projecthero.guide.thor.perk.damage_reduc: 80% less damage from every source -- falls and lightning can never hurt you
projecthero.guide.thor.perk.hammer_damag: Mjolnir itself hits for 11 swung, 18 thrown
projecthero.guide.thor.perk.hud: Your ability bar stays on screen the whole time you're bound to a hammer, even when Mjolnir isn't in your hands
projecthero.guide.thor.ability.call_mjol: Summons Mjolnir to your hand from anywhere. A plain right-click throws it instead -- no key needed. If it's already somewhere in your inventory, it swaps straight into your main hand and whatever you were holding takes its old slot. A recalled hammer lands in your main hand if it's free, otherwise the next open inventory slot -- never the off hand -- and if your hand and inventory are both full, it goes into your hand anyway and drops what you were holding. projecthero.guide.thor.ability.thundercl: A 7-block shockwave that deals 22 damage and knocks back and slows everyone nearby. Costs 10 Storm Energy.
projecthero.guide.thor.ability.hammer_vo: Mjolnir flies out of your hand and autonomously strikes every enemy within 25 blocks in sequence, closest first -- never your squadmates. If only one is in range, it orbits and re-strikes them every 2 seconds instead; with nothing in range it circles you at a 3-block radius until a target appears. Lasts 12 seconds, or until you call the hammer back early. 32-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.ability.chain_lig: Strikes everyone in a cone in front of you for 18 damage as a crackling bolt, then keeps arcing on to nearby enemies.

projecthero.guide.iron_man.body: Craft an Arc Reactor and right-click it to become Tony Stark. Tony Stark grants the knowledge to build and operate advanced Iron Man technology — the Stark Fabricator, Stark components, and the Iron Man suit progression. Without the Tony Stark power, Stark technology simply does not respond: the Fabricator will not open, and Iron Man armour is ejected from unauthorized wearers.
